iso_scope_reference_text.ISO 12944: ISO 12944 (Paints and varnishes -- Corrosion protection of steel structures by protective paint systems) specifies performance requirements, corrosivity categories (C1-C5, CX/Im immersion) and test methods for protective coating systems on structural steel, including Part 9 offshore-structure scope.
iso_scope_reference_text.ISO 3001: ISO 3001:1999 specifies a method for the determination of the epoxy equivalent, applicable to all epoxy compounds (with an epoxyamine modification in annex A). Epoxy equivalent = mass of resin in grams containing one mole of epoxy groups. Test principle: epoxy groups reacted with nascent HBr from perchloric acid and tetraethylammonium bromide -- a titrimetric method.
iso_scope_reference_text.ISO 9227: ISO 9227:2022 specifies the apparatus, the reagents and the procedure to be used in conducting the neutral salt spray (NSS), acetic acid salt spray (AASS) and copper-accelerated acetic acid salt spray (CASS) tests for assessment of the corrosion resistance of metallic materials, with or without permanent or temporary corrosion protection. Useful for detecting discontinuities such as pores and other defects in coatings.
